title: fetch_channel_map requires source; keep it matching the flow's posts
answers: Label channel listing calls with the same source as posts
body:
`fetch_channel_map(integration, *, source)` (posthog/team_notifications/slack.py:fetch_channel_map) has a required keyword `source` and builds `SlackIntegration(integration, source=source)`.
- Callers must pass the same label as the flow's `SlackIntegration` posts, so listing calls and posts land in one series. Examples: products/stamphog/backend/logic/channel_resolution.py:build_routing_context uses "stamphog"; products/visual_review/backend/logic/debt_digest.py:send_debt_digest uses "visual_review".
- Any new caller must supply `source`, and any test fake of it must accept it.
applies: Callers of fetch_channel_map and digest-style Slack flows.
says: Channel mapping requires source parameter matching posts
Slack channel listing must use same source label
Why channel resolution calls are labeled incorrectly
